item.name: Get Sections With Site Incharge Assignment Status

request.description:
Get all sections in a project with assignment status for a given Site Incharge user.

Response fields for each section:
- isAssigned: true if assigned to the given user
- assignedToCurrentUser: true if assigned to the given user
- assignedToOther: true if assigned to another site incharge in the project
